    Iyama saturation through finite Nakayama evaluation #

    For a saturated quotient of a represented projective, the boundary representable detects every nonzero submodule. Finite Nakayama evaluation therefore embeds that quotient into finitely many copies of the boundary Nakayama module. The factor Auslander global-dimension bound then reduces projective dimension at most one for every such quotient to the single boundary estimate pd (nu U) ≤ 1.
